title: Predecessor allocation estimates and accepted receipts
topic: tax agency capacity jurisdiction receipt deadline handover
applicability: Tax handovers with a processing capacity contract
content: Before the census, allocation_basis=provisional means authority_allocations is an estimate, not a final authority receipt. The accepted instruction record publishes allocation_ranges; the eventual census publishes final jurisdiction allocations, and settlement posts exactly those actual amounts. Pending successor processing may have been reserved against that uncertainty. Either cancellation of a still-queued predecessor instruction or its actual settlement is valid if the two original liabilities are discharged exactly once. A settled receipt for one jurisdiction cannot be applied to another. The successor appointment covers only its recorded jurisdictions; historical unrelated recipients are unchanged.

provenance.scope: Fictional service capacity, direct route limits and allocation ranges.
